Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing grants to the successful pilot programs implementing RCW 70.260.020.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to authorizing grants to the successful pilotprograms implementing RCW 70.260.020; and adding a new section tochapter 70.260 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.260 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Subject to the availability of amounts appropriated for thisspecific purpose, the Washington State University extension energyprogram is authorized to extend grants to the successful pilot programsimplementing RCW 70.260.020. By December 1, 2013, the Washington StateUniversity extension energy program shall provide a report to thegovernor and the appropriate legislative committee consistent with therequirements of RCW 70.260.020(5)(a). In addition to the reportrequirements in this section, the report shall include the amount spenton administration and other indirect costs. The report shall clearlydelineate the administrative costs relative to jobs produced. Forpurposes of reporting to the governor and appropriate legislativecommittees, any job or resources spent that is not directly performing p. 1 SSB 6441energy audits, weatherization, or other urban residential andcommercial energy efficiency upgrades is considered administration.
